sourceReview.excerpt:
# Cross-Section of a Prism

## Prisms

- A **prism** is a type of 3D solid with identical opposite end faces
  connected by rectangular sides.

- The **base** **of a prism** is the identical opposite end faces.

- The **height** **of a prism** is the perpendicular distance between
  the bases.

- We name prisms based on the shape of their base.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   **Triangular Prism**   **Pentagonal Prism**                                                                                  **Rectangular Prism**
  ---------------------- ---------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                                                         ![](media/Volume 1_Describe the different views of prisms and solids that have been formed from prism combinations/media/image20.png){width="0.7145833333333333in"
                                                 height="0.9604166666666667in"}![](media/Volume 1_Describe the different views of prisms and solids that have been formed from prism combinations/media/image20.png){width="1.175in"
                                                 height="0.9604166666666667in"}![](media/Volume 1_Describe the different views of prisms and solids that have been formed from prism combinations/media/image20.png){width="1.175in"
                                                                                                                           height="0.9604166666666667in"}

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
